items.title: The AI cannot invent a number
items.body: The model reads and classifies. A deterministic kernel posts, and the database refuses an unbalanced voucher.

items.title: The journal is append-only
items.body: UPDATE is revoked at the database role level. A correction is a reversing entry, never a rewrite.

items.title: Money never floats
items.body: Integer paise, end to end. No figure in your books is the result of a floating-point multiplication.

items.title: One tenant cannot see another
items.body: Row-level security under a non-owner role, so a forgotten WHERE clause cannot leak another business.

items.title: A closed period stays closed
items.body: Postings into a closed period are rejected, and closing is blocked while any posting is known to have failed.

items.title: Every figure traces to an event
items.body: The ledger is event-sourced. Any balance walks back to the settlement line that caused it.

faq.label: Straight answers
faq.heading: The questions your CA will ask.

items.question: Does this replace Tally or Zoho?
items.answer: No. CosmOS is the book of record for your marketplace business, and exports clean journal entries to whatever your CA already runs.

items.question: How is this different from a reconciliation tool?
items.answer: A reconciliation tool finds a discrepancy and hands you a spreadsheet. CosmOS quantifies it, then posts the journal entry.

items.question: Is this software or a consulting engagement?
items.answer: Software. The engagement exists to get your fee structures, channels and books into it, and what we learn doing that goes back into the product rather than into a playbook we resell.

items.question: Can the AI change my numbers?
items.answer: No. It routes questions and reads documents. Posting is deterministic, and an unbalanced entry is refused by the database.

items.question: Which marketplaces work today?
items.answer: Amazon, over SP-API. Flipkart, Meesho, Shopify and ONDC are next, along with bank statements and GSTN.

items.question: Where does GST stand?
items.answer: TCS u/s 52 and TDS u/s 194-O are tracked per settlement today. Output GST and GSTR-2B credit recovery are in build.

items.question: Is my data separate from other businesses?
items.answer: Yes, enforced by Postgres row-level security under a non-owner role, and checked by an integrity test that fails on a cross-tenant line.
